<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="H0BjQZPM6gVBdzLdrgtA"> <mxGraphModel dx="2903" dy="2260" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant P as Capsule parent
 participant I as Image and IPAM state
 participant C as Child in new namespaces
 participant N as Host bridge and firewall
 P->>I: Prepare image and retain shared layer-use lock
 P->>I: Reserve container name, IP and ports
 P->>P: Stage OverlayFS, DNS bind and volumes
 P->>C: Start child with FD 3 pipe
 Note over C: Wait before rootfs and workload setup
 P->>P: Place child in its cgroup
 P->>N: Ensure bridge and shared NAT, attach veth
 P->>C: Configure eth0 and default route
 P->>N: Write and verify veth ownership alias
 P->>N: Install this run's published-port rules
 P->>C: Write start token to FD 3
 C->>C: Set hostname, prepare rootfs and run workload
 C-->>P: Workload exits and wait returns
 P->>N: Remove this run's rules and veth
 P->>I: Release lease after successful network cleanup
 P->>P: Close child network namespace references
 P->>I: Close shared image usage lock",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
